name: git-github-workflow
description: Work safely with Git branches, commits, pull requests, reviews, CI, and repository hygiene.
---
# Git and GitHub workflow
- Inspect status, current branch, remotes, and diff before editing.
- Never force-push, rewrite shared history, or modify the default branch unless explicitly authorized.
- Use focused branches and small commits with descriptive messages.
- Keep generated files, secrets, local env files, and runtime data out of commits.
- Review the full diff before committing; link changes to tests and rationale.
- Prefer pull requests for review; summarize risks, tests, and rollback.
